## Compatibility and operations

- [ ] I identified whether this changes a public input, output, default, resource address, or runtime behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `terraform fmt -check -recursive`
- [ ] `terraform validate` for every modified module
- [ ] I reviewed a representative consumer plan for infrastructure changes, or explained why a plan is unnecessary.
